content: चक्रम् [क्रियते अनेन, कृ घञर्थे क नि˚ द्वित्वम् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 The wheel of a carriage; चक्रवत्परिवर्तन्ते दुःखानि च सुखानि च <ls>H. 1. 173</ls>. .²2 A potterʼs wheel. .²3 A sharp circular missile, weapon, a disc (especially applied to the weapon of Viṣṇu). .²4 An oil-mill; दशसूनासमं चक्रं दशचक्रसमो ध्वजः <ls>Mb. 13. 125. 9</ls>. .²5 A circle, ring; कलापचक्रेषु निवेशिताननम् <ls>Ṛs. 2. 14</ls>. .²6 A troop, multitude, collection, <ls>Śi. 20. 17</ls>. .²7 A realm, sovereignty; स्वस्थं स्वंचक्रं परचक्रमुक्तम् <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 15</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> चक्रं सैन्यरथाङ्गयोः . राष्ट्रे दम्भान्तरे … . <ls>Med.</ls> .²8 A province, district, a group of villages. .²9 A form of military array in a circle. .²10 A circle or depression of the body. .²11 A cycle, cycle of years. .²12 The horizon; यावदावर्तते चक्रं तावती मे वसुन्धरा <ls>Rām. 2. 10. 36</ls>. .²13 An army, a host. .²14 Section of a book. .²15 A whirlpool. .²16 The winding of a river. .²17 An astronomical circle; राशि˚ the zodiac. .²18 Circular flight (of birds <ab>&c.</ab>). .²19 A particular constellation in the form of a hexagon. .²20 Range, department in general. .²21 The convolutions or spiral marks of the शालिग्राम. .²22 A crooked or fraudulent contrivance. .{@-क्रः@} .²1 The ruddy goose (also called चक्रवाक); पद्मोल्लासविधायिनि सत्पथदीप्तिकृति चक्रभव्यकरे <ls>Viś. Guṇā. 274</ls>. .²2 A multitude, troop, group.
